name: Octavo published score
warning: ÉTUDE: weakened reduced-round Octavo for cryptanalysis only. NOT for secrets.
note: Étude blobs use distinct version bytes and cannot be opened by encrypt/decrypt or encrypt_movements/decrypt_movements. Current étude blobs carry a tuning commitment (like live v6/v7), binding encode_ad(ad) and, in movements, nmov. Every étude runs under its own derived key K_e (sponge domain E, round count in the tweak) and binds its version byte in the SIV nonce, so étude vectors never share round material with live blobs. 16-round permute equals the live full-round staff-core keyed by K_e.

format.etude_key: K_e = StaffSponge(b'E', seed, bytes([rounds]) + 15 zero bytes).take(128)
format.etude_siv_nonce: SHA-256(clef(K_e) || version || pickup || encode_block(msg) || encode_ad(ad))[:16]; movements: SHA-256(clef(K_e) || version || pickup || u64be(len) || msg || encode_ad(ad))[:16]
